name: Chint DDSU666 (single phase, DIN rail)
doc_revision: 'Type DDSU666.004.0006 Single phase electronic energy meter (DIN-Rail) Operation Manual', cover no. ZTY0.464.1224, May 2019 (page headers show ZTY0.464.1036). Appendix A = Modbus-RTU protocol.
notes: Built only from the manual above (Table 9 'Communication parameter information'; address column printed in hex as 0000H, 2000H, 4000H = protocol start addresses). Conversion: address_base 0, point address = the hex value converted to decimal (e.g. 2000H -> 8192, 4000H -> 16384, 0006H -> 6); no offset applied. Function codes per Appendix A: 03H read registers, 10H write multiple registers. FC04 is not mentioned in the manual, so every point uses fc 3. Measured values are 2-register single-precision floats; the manual does not state their byte/word order. Units: the manual states P in kW and Q in kvar ('the unit is KW / Kvar'); V and A per the display table; energy 'Ep' unit is not given in the register table (display shows kWh). Values are labelled 'electric quantity of the secondary side' in the manual. Config registers are 16-bit signed ('16-bit with symbols'). Baud codes (1:2400, 2:4800, 3:9600) from the note under the table (the prose also lists 1200 bps as possible but gives no code). Protocol switch register: 2 = Modbus RTU, 1 = DL/T 645-2007 (switching away from Modbus will stop Modbus comms). Address range in the keyboard section is 1-99; Appendix A allows 1-247. Default serial parameters and default address are NOT stated as such; the 'connection' block (9600 / no parity / 1 stop) is only the example shown in the manual's display table (9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit) and unit is left to the tool default. Left out: 0002H 'ClrE' energy clear (write 1), reserved registers. Newer Chinese manual ZTW0.464.0090 (2023) exists at aiot.chint.com but its text could not be read. Not verified against a physical device.
